notes.title: Bots are invading the arena in the first free update of Guilt Battle Arena available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31939758/a63a48667e8d5bbcf07ee260154aac2131a69dcc.jpg[/img]
We listened to feedback and are thrilled to release the first of 3 free updates for Guilt Battle Arena!
You can now [b]play against bots[/b] to enjoy the full Guilt Battle Arena competitive experience.
We also added a new Battle Arena option, the best set-up for your [b]party game night[/b].

Guilt Battle Arena is a frantic couch-multiplayer arena game for up to four players where [b]one bullet makes all the difference between victory and defeat![/b]

After firing your gun, you must collect your bullet before firing again. With this simple mechanic and its colorful art style, anybody can pick-up a controller and join the competitive madness.

Shoot through raining chickens, dodge exploding cats or lead homing missiles to your opponents and become the best fighter in the arena. Spice things up with gameplay modifiers, equip jetpacks or turn everyone invisible for more wackiness!

Try the new update today and have a blast with your friends and family. Your gaming nights are about to become more chaotic!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31939758/463876d319e6fdef45b12edaaed827ab75032058.jpg[/img]
